context: A dad shows his young son how to take care of the family car
purpose: Teach: 楽天/フィールド/オークション/タイヤ/マッサージ/水道/マニア/六月

lines.speaker: ryosuke_dad
lines.jp: 翔、六月の梅雨が来る前に、車の手入れをしようか。
lines.en: Sho, before the June rainy season comes, let's take care of the car.
lines.style: Warm fatherly tone, calm and inviting his son into a shared task.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: うん!パパ、まず何するの?タイヤ交換するの?
lines.en: Yeah! Dad, what do we do first? Are we changing the tires?
lines.style: Excited child voice, eager and curious, bouncing energy throughout.

lines.speaker: ryosuke_dad
lines.jp: まずタイヤの空気圧を確かめる。それからスタンドの水道で泥も流そう。
lines.en: First we check the tire pressure. Then we'll rinse off the mud with the water tap at the stand.
lines.style: Patient teaching voice, steady pace, clear instructions for a child.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: パパは車マニアだもんね!ピカピカにするの好きでしょ?
lines.en: Dad, you're a real car enthusiast, huh! You love making it sparkle, right?
lines.style: Teasing childish admiration, playful and proud of dad.

lines.speaker: ryosuke_dad
lines.jp: ははっ、まあね。ワックスは楽天市場で安く買ったんだよ。
lines.en: Haha, well, kind of. I bought the wax cheap on Rakuten.
lines.style: Casual chuckle, slightly proud bargain-hunter energy, relaxed dad-like confidence.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: へえ!中古のパーツもネットで買えるの?
lines.en: Wow! Can you buy used parts online too?
lines.style: Curious child question, genuine interest, naturally following up dad.

lines.speaker: ryosuke_dad
lines.jp: うん、ネットオークションでよく探すんだ。レース場のフィールドで使うパーツも見つかるよ。
lines.en: Yeah, I often hunt on online auctions. You can even find parts used on the racing field.
lines.style: Easygoing explanation, sharing a hobby with affection and patience.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: すごい!ぼくもボンネットの中、見てみたい!
lines.en: Cool! I want to look inside the hood too!
lines.style: Wide-eyed child wonder, bubbly enthusiasm, eager to participate.

lines.speaker: ryosuke_dad
lines.jp: いいよ。最後に座席も拭こう。パパに肩マッサージしてくれたら、ご褒美にアイスな。
lines.en: Sure. Last, let's wipe the seats too. If you give me a shoulder massage, ice cream as a reward.
lines.style: Warm laughing dad voice, gentle teasing, affectionate bargain with son.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: やった!いっぱい働く!ぼく車のプロになる!
lines.en: Yay! I'll work hard! I'm gonna be a car pro!
lines.style: Triumphant child shout, full of motivation and pride, energetic finish.
